title: chloropyron maritimum subsp. canescens
intro: Chloropyron maritimum subsp. canescens, commonly known as California buckwheat, is a plant species native to the Pacific coast of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to help lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation, which may contribute to its use in managing cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chloropyron maritimum subsp. canescens may also include its ability to exhibit vasodilatory and anti-cancer effects.
